pages.text: The $(d)Coal Generator$() $(9)burns furnace fuels to generate FE$().$(br2)Furnace fuels that burn longer produce more FE.$(br2)The amount is configurable, but defaults to 6FE/t. With this, $(9)1 Coal generates 9,600 FE$().
If the Coal Generator fills up with fuel burning, it $(9)pauses until it has room for more energy$(), preventing waste!
